name: Haiyang Xu
headline: Security Operations · Incident Response · Cloud Security
summary: Engineer at Seatrium, focused on SOC L2 investigations and incident response. I handle cases escalated by BlueVoyant's L1 team, investigate alerts in Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel, and take action to secure affected accounts.

bullets: Handle Tier 2 investigations for cases escalated by BlueVoyant’s L1 team, investigating Microsoft Defender XDR alerts involving compromised accounts, phishing, malware, endpoint threats, and suspicious network activity.
Analyze Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and audit logs, perform password resets and session revocation, verify MFA configuration, and coordinate remediation with affected users.
Conduct threat hunting with Microsoft Sentinel and KQL to investigate anomalies and validate endpoint telemetry.
Configure Microsoft Purview DLP policies, manage Defender Indicators for malicious IPs and file hashes, and investigate phishing campaigns.
Conduct firewall testing and support AWS security log validation alongside cloud infrastructure teams.
Integrated OWASP ZAP, GitHub Actions, and SonarQube into web and API security testing workflows.
Built AWS Lambda and API Gateway workflows for security alert processing and categorization.
Automated log analysis and report generation with Python and Shell scripts.
Developed user-activity anomaly detection using TensorFlow and scikit-learn, with feature engineering to improve detection quality.
Built Python/Flask microservices backed by MySQL and optimized queries and caching.
Integrated automated testing and vulnerability scans into GitLab CI/CD and Docker workflows.
Connected industrial hardware to AWS IoT Core, Lambda, and DynamoDB for real-time data processing.
Built React and Node.js dashboards to help technicians monitor equipment and operational data.
Connected sensors and backend services with AWS IoT Core, Lambda, and S3, and automated agricultural data processing.
Built a React and Flask dashboard for sensor visualization and remote environmental control.
